title: Kelp
body:
Description

Kelp is a tree which can be found underwater nearby Finlay Island and Ferwater Island.

The sanded variant of Kelp is a slightly lighter shade than sanded Finlay Clover. This makes it a great cheap alternative to making grass on your base.

Note: The minimum axe required to chop down is a steel axe, any axe above the steel axe can chop it down.

Trivia

  • The green grass texture makes it perfect for making foliage on your plot
  • The sanded kelp material and color is similar to sanded Green Mushroom.
  • There is a rare chance that when sanding Kelp, it becomes glitched in such a way that it is "skinny."
  • Since 11/01/23 (v1.43.1), the starter ruins now use Kelp as vines instead of Finlay Clover.
